integrity: The stated classification is proved by direct local-field case analysis and exact multinomial counting; independent standard-library programs check small configurations and weighted four-type cases. No independent expert review or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The result applies to synchronized open-neighbor binary majority with retention at ties on K_2 Cartesian K_n, n>=2, and gives total oscillatory basin size, not per-orbit attraction basins or nonuniform initial measures. Finite verification cannot certify infinite n. Equivalent results outside the inspected literature remain possible. The 1980 foundational paper was available at abstract level only; external audit has not been performed.
title: The oscillation basin of two matched cliques has an exact parity law
